sources.title: The Governor of Svalbard (Sysselmesteren), Entry and residence
sources.said: Although Svalbard is part of Norway, the Immigration Act does not apply to the archipelago. Foreigners do not need a visa or work and residence permits from the Norwegian authorities to travel to Svalbard. … Although you do not need a visa or your own work and residence permit, everyone must meet certain requirements in order to stay in Svalbard.

note: Confirmed free: the Immigration Act doesn't apply to Svalbard, so no work permit is asked of anyone; everyone must have the means to live there, and those who need a Schengen visa need one to pass through mainland Norway (the visits engine's).
